title: New Senate CLARITY Act draft allows activity-based stablecoin rewards
summary: A revised Senate CLARITY Act draft would allow activity-based stablecoin rewards tied to payments, wallets and staking, while barring interest paid solely for holding tokens.

title: VanEck: Clarity will turn Q1 into a ‘risk-on’ quarter for investors
summary: VanEck predicts investors will be more confident in Q1, citing improved fiscal visibility and monetary clarity, though the jury is still out on how Bitcoin fits into this picture.

title: Bitwise calls 401(k) Bitcoin allergy 'ridiculous' as Warren presses SEC
summary: US President Donald Trump opened the door for cryptocurrencies to be included in 401(k) retirement plans in August last year with an executive order.

title: Court temporarily stops Tennessee from taking action against Kalshi
summary: Kalshi is free to continue operating in Tennessee for now, as a federal judge blocked state regulators from taking action after the prediction market sued.

title: SEC boss bullish Trump will sign market structure bill this year
summary: Securities and Exchange Commission chair Paul Atkins voiced strong support for the bipartisan legislation aimed at moving crypto markets out of a regulatory gray zone.

title: Banks’ stablecoin concerns are ‘unsubstantiated myths‘: Professor
summary: A Columbia Business School professor debunked five banking industry misunderstandings about stablecoin yields as the market structure bill heads for markups this month.

title: Ex-NYC mayor unveils ‘NYC Token’ memecoin weeks after leaving office
summary: The NYC Token, which had a pretty rocky start, has been created to fight antisemitism, according to former New York City Mayor Eric Adams.

title: Trump wants tech firms to ‘pay their own way’ as power demand soars
summary: The POTUS demanded tech giants cover data center power costs as US consumption surged, with Microsoft first to make changes this week.

title: Meta to cut 10% of metaverse arm this week amid AI push: Report
summary: Meta’s Reality Labs is set for cuts as the firm’s metaverse budget continues to decline amid push toward artificial intelligence development.

title: US Senate Agriculture Committee delays crypto market structure bill markup
summary: Senate Agriculture Committee Chairman John Boozman says he’s delayed work on a crypto market structure bill to have more time to secure bipartisan support.
